scope: DXF PDFUNDERLAY/DGNUNDERLAY/DWFUNDERLAY callback placement conversion when dxfRW::read explicitly requests applyExtrusion; no physical-source or support claim

authority.title: Autodesk UNDERLAY (DXF)
rules: Underlay group codes are shared by PDFUNDERLAY, DGNUNDERLAY and DWFUNDERLAY entities.
Groups 10/20/30 store the insertion point in OCS/ECS; groups 210/220/230 store the normal in WCS.
Group 50 rotation is relative to the OCS/ECS X axis and around its Z axis.
Groups 11/21 are 2D clipping points in OCS/ECS and remain local to the underlay.

authority.title: Autodesk Object Coordinate Systems (DXF)
authority.rule: The OCS basis is computed from the extrusion normal using the arbitrary-axis algorithm.

behavior: DRW_Underlay::parseCode marks an explicit group 210 normal so the opt-in conversion follows existing entity semantics.
DRW_Underlay::applyExtrusion converts only the insertion position through the existing arbitrary-axis basis.
processUnderlay invokes conversion only for dxfRW::read(..., applyExtrusion=true); default false retains OCS/ECS coordinates.
Rotation, WCS normal and local clipping coordinates remain unchanged.

generatedControl.applyExtrusionFalse: Each callback retains its OCS/ECS insertion coordinates.
generatedControl.preservationControl: All three callbacks retain the (1,0,0) normal, 30-degree local rotation, and the two local clipping rectangle points.
generatedControl.fixtureDisposition: Generated in a temporary directory by the test and deleted; no DWG/DXF fixture committed.

limitations: Generated parser/callback controls only; no physical producer or paired-source evidence was used.
The generated entity records do not resolve an underlay definition handle and therefore are not whole-document validity evidence.
No native LibreCAD, LibreCAD_3, FreeCAD or other consumer placement check was performed.
The control does not qualify external underlay loading, other scale/clip profiles, or 3D rendering.
This does not promote a format-support claim.
